## Hypothesis

We hypothesize that a scalper strategy with quick profit targets (75% premium gain) and tight stop (35% premium loss) combined with a time stop (12 minutes) and ITM-2 puts can capture intraday momentum in SPY 0DTE options. The chandelier profit-lock and vol filter aim to avoid false breaks and ride stronger moves.

## Mechanism

Enter on a signal (trigger not specified in keeper data, assumed to be the shotgun_scalper_stage5's entry logic) when vol_ratio_threshold > 1.2. Exit at the first of: 75% premium gain, 35% premium loss, or 12 minutes time stop. Trade ITM-2 puts (strike_offset=2). Apply chandelier profit-lock: arm at 60% of premium gain, trail 15% from high-water mark (assuming chandelier_arm_pct=0.6 means arm at 60% and trail 15%? but not specified in the combo, so we assume standard chandelier with trail_pct=0.15).
